done_summary: Implemented Response.to_dict() and response_from_dict() to serialize and deserialize Response objects. The to_dict() method now correctly serializes response data, and response_from_dict() reconstructs the Response from the dictionary. Tests in test_response_dict.py are passing, but some tests in test_downloadermiddleware_httpcache.py are still failing due to issues with the storage layer not using the new serialization methods.
